pool.definition: .ebd essential bits whose LA falls in a frame-table v2 core-region column; exclude only ECC word 50 and still-dead frames/probes (WP6 3.2); no functional pruning
pool.storage: deterministic regeneration only (ebd + frame table v2, both frozen); per-bit list NOT stored in the repo (WP6 3.3 spirit); meta + spot bits in <out>/<design>/pool_v2_meta.json

definitions.shot_protocol: SEM I -> N <lfa> per bit (1 bit singles, 2 bits pairs) -> write 10 rand_full frames -> run -> read output -> read telemetry -> SEM O repair -> verify repair report -> health shot (WP6 2.1); inputs rewritten every shot, so shell reset reload is built in

result_categories.rule: 运行未完成: run_error (stream-engine watchdog ~64 ms)、写入或读出错误、主机超时
运行完成; 8 帧逐位一致且尾两帧全零; det = cor = unc = 0; err_flags = 0
运行完成; 输出逐位一致; cor > 0 或 det > 0; unc = 0
运行完成; 输出不一致; unc > 0
运行完成; 输出不一致; unc = 0 (另记 cor/det; cor > 0 的列为误纠子行)
运行完成; 输出一致; unc > 0 (罕见, 单列)

definitions.tmr_silent_rule: 标出只认 unc。三模级的不一致标志对每个被屏蔽的单故障都会拉起，系统无法据它区分一份副本坏与两份副本坏，所以三模输出出错一律记静默，不记标出；正文写明。
definitions.tmr_silent_rule_key: 若输出不一致且 unc > 0，但目标位归属三模级，类别记 silent 并记 tmr_override = true
definitions.library_L: 单发预筛里类别为已纠正、err_flags = 0、且 SEM 修复报告确认该位被纠正的位 (WP6 2.3)
definitions.lane: 遥测 last_loc (0-3 功能路、4-5 校验路), 仅编码级
definitions.replica: 三模级只能由瓦片归属给出; 归属不唯一记 未定
definitions.stage_conflict_policy: 遥测级与瓦片归属级不一致时保留该位、单独标出 (stage_conflict = true); 遥测只留最后一个事件的级与路；一发若在几级都有事件，以瓦片归属复核，复核不了记 多级。遥测无法单独检出多级事件（只有 last_*），检出依赖瓦片归属复核。
position_categories: 受算术码保护的数据通路
definitions.position_category_note: 按瓦片归属 (WP6 2.4)；归属不唯一或跨类记 混合；3.3 特殊位置(tile_x49 列、P1 的 INT_R_X51Y156 / INT_R_X53Y152、X0Y4 tile_x23) 单列。

f_bar.text: f̄ = Σ_{编码级 s} (n_s/n)²·(1−Σ_l q_{s,l}²) + Σ_{三模级 s} (n_s/n)²·(1−Σ_r p_{s,r}²)；n = |L|，n_s 为第 s 级位数，q_{s,l} 为编码级第 l 路占比，p_{s,r} 为三模级第 r 副本占比（未定的按 1/3）。假设：同一恢复边界内不同路/不同副本的两错必失效，其余都不失效 (WP6 2.5)
f_bar.assumption: 同一恢复边界内不同路/不同副本的两错必失效，其余都不失效

sample_sizes.standby_spare: ceil(5% of singles), pre-drawn, consumed in order for voided shots; sampling order of the primary list never changes

seeds.per_design_derivation: seed(design) = base_seed + 104729 * design_index (P0=0, P1=1, S0=2, S1=3)

sampling.singles: uniform without replacement from pool v2; primary 5000 + standby ceil(5%) drawn in one pass
sampling.pairs_natural: uniform over unordered distinct-bit pairs of L (i, j i.i.d. uniform, order normalised), rejection-sampling out same-frame pairs (same la); skipped draws counted
sampling.pairs_stress: uniform (rejection) over qualified pairs: same stage AND (ECC stage: different last_loc) / (TMR stage: different replica, unique-attribution bits only); same-frame pairs rejected; shortfall: draw all available, report deficit, never relax criteria
sampling.pairs_control: same as stress but same lane (ECC) / same replica (TMR, unique attribution)

recovery_gradient: 1. 每发后 SEM O，等修复报告；核对帧/字/位与注入位一致（配对两位都要出现）
2. 健康发: 逐位一致且计数全 0 才继续
3. 不通过: 再 SEM O、再健康发 (recovery_path = repeat_O)
4. 仍不通过或 SEM 报不可纠 (FC 40): 核对冻结位流 SHA-256 后用同一冻结位流重编程 (vivado program_k7_volatile.tcl)，SEM 状态，连续 3 发健康发 (recovery_path = reprogram)；该发自己的类别按原判定不变
5. 重编程后仍不通过: 停整批 (CampaignStop)
6. 外壳一旦复位 (上电、时钟失锁、主机重连): 重新初始化，连续 3 发健康发全部无影响后再继续，记录在案 (shell_resets 记录)
void_rule: 主机通信超时导致的单发作废 (category = invalid)，记 作废，用预登记里预抽的备用位依次补，不改抽样顺序

pilot_gates.when: after the first 300 shots of a full-size singles run
gates: 恢复梯度从未走到 重编程仍失败 (CampaignStop)
已纠正占比按试运行比例外推到 5000 发 >= 100 位 L
单发平均耗时写进报告
pilot_gates.on_fail: abort this design with a pilot report

stop_conditions: 可重复性抽检不一致超过 5 发
某设计的 L 少于 100 位
某设计加压配对合格位对总数少于 50 (分项缺额只报告、不停)
jsonl_record_fields: sem (I/N/O replies + repair report parse + repair_match)

tile_table_schema.note: WP6 3.3 output, written by scripts/k7_mod/wp6_tile_table.py (Vivado query); absence must be tolerated (category/replica resolve to 未定 at analysis time)
tile_table_schema.tile_name: <frame-table column tile_kind>_X<tile_x>Y<tile_y>; row = word//2 (word<50), (word-1)//2 (word>50), word 50 = ECC; tile_y = 50*region_y + row (verified against the .ll by row_check.json)

categories.protected_datapath: 受算术码保护的数据通路

tile_table_schema.unique_rule: 瓦片 attrib 集合唯一（单条）时归属唯一；多条记 未定/混合 (WP6 2.3)
